notes: Proto Labs is a digital manufacturing service provider, not an equipment maker; equipment facets mostly do not apply.

machinery_computer_equipment_category.value: No equipment sold; on-demand custom part manufacturing service (injection molding, CNC machining, 3D printing, sheet metal) using own machines and partner network

installed_equipment_base.value: Does not sell equipment to customers; machines are used in its own digital factories

aftermarket_sales_mix.value: No equipment aftermarket; revenue from custom parts, with repeat reorders of production parts

equipment_replacement_cycle.value: No equipment sold to customers, so no customer replacement cycle

engineering_customization.value: Made-to-order custom parts from customer CAD files, with automated quoting, design-for-manufacturability feedback and configurable materials and lead times

service_maintenance_requirement.value: No equipment maintenance; customers get order support, quality documentation and production experts
